position: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS): Medicare Regulatory Reforms
proposal: The Mandate recommends that CMS eliminate the Medicare inpatient-only list, expand the ambulatory surgical center covered procedures list, and extend site-neutral payment so that Medicare pays the same for a service whether delivered in a physician office, clinic or hospital outpatient department.

second_review.operative_ask: CMS should, by regulation, advance site neutrality by eliminating the Medicare inpatient-only list, expanding the ambulatory surgical center covered procedures list and extending site-neutral payment to more settings (page 464).
second_review.rule_applied: Implemented. Test (a): yes in substance; the CY 2026 OPPS/ASC final rule, in effect since 2026-01-01, finalizes elimination of the inpatient-only list over three years with the full list gone by 2029-01-01 (per a rule summary by the American Society of Hematology) and removes the first 285 services, adds 276 procedures plus 271 former inpatient-only codes to the ASC list, and extends the physician fee schedule equivalent rate to drug administration at excepted off-campus departments. Test (b): nothing is different from or opposite to the ask; the rural sole community hospital exemption narrows but does not reverse it. Test (c): the ask is regulatory and needs no act of Congress. In_progress is not the better fit because the rule is final and effective and the elimination is a finalized policy on a schedule, not a pending proposal; completed is not reached because the list still exists until 2029 and site-neutral payment covers few services.

status_summary: The CY 2026 outpatient payment final rule, published 2025-11-25 and effective 2026-01-01, finalizes a three-year phase-out of the inpatient-only list (the end year is not stated in the rule text or the CMS fact sheet as read) and removes 285 services in the first year; it adds 289 procedures to the ASC covered procedures list according to the CMS fact sheet of 2025-11-21 (an earlier reading of the rule text gave 276) plus 271 codes leaving the inpatient-only list, and pays the physician fee schedule equivalent rate for drug administration at excepted off-campus hospital departments, exempting rural sole community hospitals. The CY 2027 final rule with comment period (CMS-1850-FC), published 2026-11-06 and effective 2027-01-01, removes 637 more services from the list as the second year of the phase-out, adds 618 ASC codes, and extends the equivalent rate to imaging without contrast at those departments, again exempting rural sole community hospitals. The stage is implemented because the elimination policy, ASC expansion and site-neutral extension are operative through a final rule, while the list remains in place until the phase-out ends and site-neutral payment so far reaches only selected services.

timeline.event: CY 2026 OPPS/ASC final rule published: inpatient-only list phase-out begins with 285 removals, ASC list additions, and a physician fee schedule equivalent rate for drug administration at excepted off-campus departments.
CY 2027 OPPS/ASC proposed rule published: would remove 637 services from the inpatient-only list, add 618 ASC codes, and apply the equivalent rate to certain imaging codes; comments due 2026-08-31.

CY 2027 OPPS/ASC final rule with comment period (CMS-1850-FC, RIN 0938-AV83, FR Doc. 2026-22739) published, effective 2027-01-01: removes 637 services from the inpatient-only list as the second year of the three-year phase-out, adds 618 codes to the ASC covered procedures list, and extends the physician fee schedule equivalent rate (volume control method) to imaging without contrast at excepted off-campus provider-based departments, exempting rural sole community hospitals.

title: Phase out the Medicare inpatient-only list and expand ASC and site-neutral payment
uncertainties: Only about the first 100,000 characters of the CY 2027 proposed rule were read; the page text of the CY 2026 final rule was read to its end on 2026-10-23. A full-elimination date of 2029-01-01 for the inpatient-only list appears only in a rule summary by the American Society of Hematology (hematology.org), an unverified lead at low confidence; the final rule text on federalregister.gov, the CMS fact sheet of 2025-11-21 and the CY 2027 proposed rule (first 100,000 characters) state a three-year phase-out beginning with 285 services in CY 2026 but no end year, and (inference) a three-year schedule from CY 2026 would end around the start of 2029; the CMS fact sheet counts 289 procedures added to the ASC covered procedures list, where an earlier reading of the rule text gave 276, and does not say how that count relates to the 271 former inpatient-only codes it also lists as added; whether the full schedule is codified at 42 CFR 419.22 or set out only in preamble tables was not confirmed. The CY 2027 final rule was read in this review only through the CMS fact sheet of 2026-11-04 and the public inspection copy on public-inspection.federalregister.gov; the fact sheet does not state the number of ASC covered procedures added for CY 2027 or the year in which the list will be fully eliminated. An independent review on 2026-11-06 read the front matter of the public inspection copy (about the first 100,000 of 117,271 characters), which gives the rule as CMS-1850-FC with an effective date of 2027-01-01 and comments due 2027-01-04, and counts 618 codes added to the ASC covered procedures list; the fact sheet labels the rule CMS-1850-F. Neither source states the end year of the phase-out; a three-year schedule begun in CY 2026 would place the last removals in CY 2028 (inference). No litigation over the drug administration payment change was searched in this review.
